features.feature: Parallel Development capability doc adds an explicit Authority Modes And Evidence Chains matrix that separates local/off lifecycle evidence, shadow transport or diagnostic evidence, and receipt-backed L2+ authority evidence without claiming runtime enforcement.

Parallel Development final-report example, readiness checklist, DONE criteria, and anti-patterns use the authorityMode/evidenceClass/receiptVerified/productionDone/authorityChanged/authorityReceiptRefs boundary consistently and keep it future-facing until a verified receipt-backed path exists.
